feedback.correct: You chose the kind way! Tara does a happy twirl for you!
feedback.retry: Try again, no rush. What would kind Tara do?

hint_sequence: Tara reads the question again, slowly and softly.
Tara points at each choice — look at them one by one.
Tara starts the kind choice for you — 'SHA-re…' Which one begins that way?

interactions.prompt: Bobo wants a turn with Tara's crayons. What should Tara do?
Put Tara's three sharing steps in the right order.
Bobo gets the last mango slice. How does Bobo feel?

objective: Practise sharing and turn-taking: recognize kind choices, put the steps of sharing in order, and decide what to do when a friend wants a turn.
off_screen: Share something today — a toy, a snack, or a turn — with a friend or sibling, and tell your grown-up about it.
parent_note: Values: sharing, turn-taking. Scenario-based kind choices plus ordering the three steps of sharing; Tara narrates and encourages.

story_beats.art_note: Warm morning light under a mango tree; Tara the orange squirrel holds up a big golden mango, basket full, two more on the grass.
story_beats.text: Tara finds three ripe mangoes under the big tree. 'Mmm, sweet!' she sniffs. 'One for me, one for Bobo, and one for Momo.' She gathers them into her basket.

story_beats.art_note: Bobo looking up hopefully; Tara places a mango slice on a leaf for him, both smiling.
story_beats.text: Bobo the little tortoise hurries over, eyes wide. 'Can I have a turn?' Tara smiles. 'Of course! Sharing is how friends make good things BIGGER.'

story_beats.art_note: Three clear panels: Tara asking (speech bubble 'Want some?'), Tara passing the slice, Bobo bowing 'Thank you!'
story_beats.text: Tara teaches the three steps of sharing. 'First you ASK. Then you PASS. Then you SAY thank you. Watch me — and then you try with me!'
'Now it's YOUR turn to help me decide,' says Tara. 'Some choices are kind, and some are not-so-kind. Let's pick the kind ones — together!'
'You are a sharing star!' Tara twirls her tail. 'Remember — sharing a toy, a snack, or a turn makes playtime happy for EVERYONE.'

subject: values
title: Tara Shares Her Mangoes
transfer_question: At playtime today, share one toy or one snack, and tell a grown-up how it felt.
